newsitem.title: UK: Birmingham Midshires pretax profit rises 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham Midshires pretax profit rises 13 pct.

text.p: Birmingham Midshires Building Society, the UK's ninth largest, on Tuesday reported a 13 percent hike in its pre-tax profits at 70.7 million stg for the year to December 31, 1996.
Gross lending for Birmingham rose to 814.6 million stg from 614.6 million in the previous year. Total managed assets increased to 7.76 billion stg from 7.72 billion.
The society's net interest income rose 11 percent to 133.3 million stg from 120.6 million.
Birmingham's net retail receipts, including interest credited during the year, was 457.6 million stg, 60.7 million higher than 1995.
For the first time the society had one million savers.
Post-tax profit for Birmingham rose five percent to 45.2 million stg from 43.1 million.
